_readme: Edit hospital details here, then run `node build.mjs`. Set a value's `verified` flag to true only after the hospital has confirmed it. Unverified phone numbers are shown as text without click-to-call; the emergency line is hidden entirely until verified. No street address is shown on the site; add an `address` block and location sections back only once the hospital confirms it. Set emailVerified to true once the email addresses are real, to show the "Send by email" option on forms.
name: WeCare Hospital

hours.opd: Mon to Sat, 8:00 am to 8:00 pm

forms._readme: Leave endpoint empty to send enquiries through WhatsApp or email from the visitor's own device. To collect them in a Google Sheet, deploy scripts/google-sheet-endpoint.gs as a web app and paste its URL here.
